summary: SkinHealth Systems Inc. filed an 8-K on June 22, 2026, reporting a securities class action settlement entered on June 17, 2026. The company agreed to an $18 million cash settlement, of which it pays $3 million with $15 million from insurers. No admission of wrongdoing. Pending court approval, the settlement covers shareholders from May 10, 2022 to November 13, 2023. Plaintiffs may seek up to $5.4 million in fees. This is a legal settlement disclosure, not a special situation such as a merger, tender, or restructuring.
